role: Software Engineer Intern for Film Production Startup Founded by Sony alumni
jd:
Company Description 


Oakridge is a film production startup founded by Sony Pictures alumni, bringing studio-level expertise to a nimble, innovative environment. 


Prospective interns are encouraged to connect with current or former Oakridge interns to learn more about the culture, projects, and growth opportunities at the Story Company.


Role Description 


As a Software Engineer Intern at Oakridge, you will support the development of tools and platforms that streamline film production workflows and enhance creative collaboration. 


This is an unpaid internship programme designed for university students eligible to earn college credit for their participation.


Day-to-day responsibilities may include writing and testing code, debugging issues, contributing to feature development, and documenting technical solutions. You will collaborate closely with engineers, product stakeholders, and production team members to understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. This is a remote internship role, offering flexible collaboration across time zones and the opportunity to gain real-world experience in both software engineering and film production.


Qualifications
 

- Strong foundation in software development concepts and proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Java, C++).
- Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, version control (e.g., Git), and basic testing practices.
- Proficient with AI software building tools 
- Ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and collaborate effectively in a remote team environment.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation of technical work.
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Familiarity with web technologies, cloud services, or scripting for automation is a plus.
- Interest in film, storytelling, or the entertainment industry is strongly beneficial.
fit_why: Generic SWE intern; strong web/Python overlap, unpaid, film-domain interest
